description: C54 — 链接双车 - 第8局：叠车接力突破（意大利开局C54）

intro.popup_en:
Rook Relay in Practice, Game 8
A classic C54 Italian Game. Follow the journey of White's rooks: Re1, Rxe6, Red6, Rd7, and finally Rxd7.
intro.popup:
叠车接力实战第8局
C54意大利开局经典实战
关注白方车的整个旅程：
Re1 → Rxe6 → Red6 → Rd7 → Rxd7！

outro.popup_en: The complete rook relay: Re1 prepares the rooks; Rxe6 is the first rook's breakthrough; Red6 advances it; Rd7+ forces Black's rook to respond; then the second rook captures on d7. A full-game demonstration of the relay idea.
outro.popup:
总结：叠车接力全过程
①第7步Re1：易位后立即激活，为双车连接做准备
②第28步Rxe6：前车突破！
③第31步Red6：前车继续推进
④第32步Rd7+：前车将军，黑车被迫应接
⑤第33步Rxd7+：后车接手！——这就是一局精彩的全局演示！

moves.popup_en: 1.e4 begins the Italian Game, here in the C54 Giuoco Piano variation.
moves.popup:
1.e4 意大利开局开始
C54 吉奥科·钢琴变例

moves.popup_en: Nf3 develops and attacks e5.
moves.popup: Nf3！马出动，攻击e5

moves.popup_en: Bc4! The Italian bishop targets Black's weakness on f7.
moves.popup:
Bc4！意大利象！
直指黑方f7弱点

moves.popup_en: c3 is a characteristic Giuoco Piano move, preparing the central advance d4.
moves.popup:
c3！吉奥科·钢琴特征步
为d4中心推进做准备

moves.popup_en: d3 builds a steady center and prepares development and castling.
moves.popup:
d3！稳健建立中心
为轻子发展和易位铺路

moves.popup_en: O-O! White castles. The rook is now on f1 and ready to become active on the next move.
moves.popup:
O-O易位！
注意底线：Rf1就位
下一步白车将立即激活！

moves.popup_en: Re1! White activates the rook immediately after castling, placing it on the central e-file. This begins the rook-relay plan.
moves.popup:
Re1！易位后第一步就激活车！
Rf1→e1，占据e列中心通道
这是整个叠车接力的起点！

moves.popup_en: Nbd2! The queenside knight moves out, clearing b1, c1, and d1 so the rooks can coordinate more easily.
moves.popup:
Nbd2！后翼马移位
b1-c1-d1继续腾空，双车协调更顺畅

moves.popup_en: Bxe6! White initiates an exchange, opening the f-file and damaging Black's structure after ...fxe6.
moves.popup:
Bxe6！主动兑换！
打开f列，黑方e6被fxe6破坏,
白方获得结构优势

moves.popup_en: b4! White expands on the queenside and gains space.
moves.popup:
b4！翼冲！
抢占空间，后翼行动开始

moves.popup_en: Be3 develops the bishop actively and watches for the black knight's route toward g4.
moves.popup:
Be3！象发展到活跃位置
同时看住黑马跑向g4

moves.popup_en: Bxa7 wins a pawn by exchanging bishops and forces Black's rook away from its favorable position.
moves.popup:
Bxa7！兑象得兵
黑车被迫离开得利位置

moves.popup_en: d4! White launches the key central counterbreak.
moves.popup:
d4！中心突破！
白方启动关键的中心反击

moves.popup_en: Nxd4 places the knight on a strong central square.
moves.popup: Nxd4！马占据d4强格

moves.popup_en: Nxc6 exchanges Black's knight and damages the queenside pawn structure.
moves.popup:
Nxc6！兑换黑马
破坏黑方后翼兵型

moves.popup_en: e5! White advances the pawn chain and increases the central space advantage.
moves.popup:
e5！兵链推进！
白方中心优势扩大

moves.popup_en: exd6 exchanges pawns and opens the d-file for the rooks.
moves.popup:
exd6！兵兑换
打开d列，双车准备发力

moves.popup_en: Nxd6! The knight occupies a powerful outpost. Now watch how Re1 breaks through.
moves.popup:
Nxd6！马进驻d6强格！
现在注意观察：Re1如何突破

moves.popup_en: Qe4! The queens are about to be exchanged, bringing the rooks to the forefront.
moves.popup:
Qe4！
后马即将兑换，局面进入车的世界！

moves.popup_en: Kh2 steps away from check. Re1 has guarded the e-file for a long time and is about to become decisive.
moves.popup:
Kh2！王躲避将军
注意：此时Re1已经守了很久e列
即将派上大用场！

moves.popup_en: Nxe4 exchanges the remaining queenside pieces. The position simplifies into a rook endgame, where White's rooks can begin their relay.
moves.popup:
Nxe4！后马相继兑换
局势简化，进入车的端局
白方双车将发动叠车接力！

moves.popup_en: Nxf2 captures the pawn on f2 as the position simplifies further.
moves.popup:
Nxf2！马吃掉f2兵
局势继续简化

moves.popup_en: Rxf2 recaptures the knight. White now has two rooks, on f2 and e1; the relay is about to begin.
moves.popup:
Rxf2！车吃回马
现在白方双车：Rxf2 + Re1
接力序列即将开始！

moves.popup_en: Rxe6! The front rook breaks through, moving from e1 to e6 deep in Black's position. This is the first step of the relay.
moves.popup:
Rxe6！前车突破！
Re1→e6，车深入敌阵
叠车接力第一步：前车冲锋！

moves.popup_en: ...Rc8 brings Black's rook back to defend.
moves.popup: Rc8！黑车回防

moves.popup_en: Rd1! The rear rook joins from a1, preparing to use the d-file. Re6 leads in front, with Rd1 following behind.
moves.popup:
Rd1！后车进场！
Ra1→d1，准备沿d列接力
注意：Re6在前，Rd1在后！

moves.popup_en: ...Rc2 counterattacks on c2, but White is prepared.
moves.popup:
Rc2！黑车反压c2
但白方早有准备

moves.popup_en: Rd3! The rear rook takes its relay position. The path from d3 to d7 is clear, with the front rook on e6.
moves.popup:
Rd3！后车就位！
d3→d7通路清晰
前车在e6，后车在d3——接力箭在弦上！

moves.popup_en: ...Kf7 brings Black's king into the game.
moves.popup: Kf7！黑王出来走走

moves.popup_en: Red6! The front rook moves from e6 to d6, pressuring d7. Both white rooks are now on the d-file.
moves.popup:
Red6！前车继续推进！
Re6→d6，紧逼d7
现在双车都在d列！

moves.popup_en: ...Rc7 defends the c7-square.
moves.popup: Rc7！黑车守住c7

moves.popup_en: Rd7+! The front rook invades with check. Black is forced to capture it, exactly as White intended.
moves.popup:
Rd7+！前车将军！
前车突入d7，黑车被迫吃掉——
这正是叠车接力的设计！

moves.popup_en: ...Rxd7 Black's rook captures the invading front rook, just as White planned.
moves.popup:
Rxd7！黑车被迫吃前车
——正中白方下怀！

moves.popup_en: Rxd7+! The relay is complete: the rook from d3 takes over on d7 after the first rook breaks through and draws Black's rook away.
moves.popup:
Rxd7+！叠车接力完成！
Rd3接手d7！
前车突破 → 黑车应接 → 后车接手
这就是叠车接力的精髓！

moves.popup_en: ...Kf6 escapes. White's two rooks can continue coordinating to exert pressure in the endgame.
moves.popup:
Kf6！黑王逃跑
接下来白方两车继续协同，发挥残局压制力
